Zone D · the resonance lab

The Resonance Lab

Ti verifies against its lattice and Fi against a core tone. Fe verifies against the field between people, so this lab spawns its events into the room rather than into the chamber. Three make it more coherent, three take something away — and one of them costs more than the other five combined.

Reading the glyph: each person carries a hand showing their phase — when the room agrees, the hands line up. The band around the nucleus is the room's colours by weight, and the disc inside it is their average. That disc is the only colour Fe has.
